name: date_parse
description: Parse dates, times and durations into ISO 8601: ISO forms (dates, basic and extended date-times with offsets, week and ordinal dates, durations like P1DT2H), numeric dates with a stated day-first or month-first order, month names, and English and Spanish relative forms (tomorrow, next Monday, in 3 days, 3 weeks ago, mañana, el próximo lunes, hace 3 días) computed from a given reference date. Names the rule that matched; never reads the clock.

reference.description: Required for relative forms and dates without a year

date_order.description: How to read 05/10/2026; required when both numbers are 12 or less

catalog.source: ISO 8601-1:2019 (date, time and duration formats); natural-language subset modelled on dateparser (scrapinghub/dateparser), stdlib only
